summary: Verified the /api/img robustness refactor. DEDUP: after rm -rf /tmp/ynnck-img (which also exercises the lazy mkdir in render_all), 6 parallel public-URL requests for the same src with w=480/800/1200/1600/800/1600 all returned 200 valid WEBP. The backend log showed exactly ONE upstream GET for that object, and all widths were rendered with no .tmp leftovers. TIMEOUT: an in-process unit test (build_images mocked as slow, wait_for timeout shortened) confirmed 3 concurrent requests get 503 with Retry-After: 10 while the shielded task keeps running (called once), then caches; the next request returns 200 and IMG_TASKS is cleaned up. Validation: foreign host, '..', backslash, w=801 -> 400; w=abc -> 422; missing upstream object -> 404. Regression: /api/experiences (4 items), /api/experiences/{id} for all 4, unknown id 404, sitemap 200 with 5 <loc>. Full suite: 45/46 passed; the 1 failure was a stale test calling the removed render_webp, which I updated to render_all and which now passes. UI: home #work shows 4 cards with images on desktop and mobile (no horizontal overflow). All 4 detail heroes load at 1600, the OVB video has readyState 4, and the 3f4564a9 body image (editor/74ff2a08) loads at 1200 once cached. No console errors and no 4xx/5xx in the final runs. The cache is left warm: 20 files (4 heroes x 4 widths plus the body image x 4 widths).

minor.issue: warm_images only pre-warms article hero images (image_url). Body/editor images such as editor/74ff2a08...jpg (in the 3f4564a9 article) are not pre-warmed. While the cache was cold, upstream returned 504 after 60s (direct curl) plus 503 SlowDown. The browser then got 503 after 45s, twice in a row, until the upstream recovered about 3 minutes later (then 200 in 20s, cached at 0.23s). Suggestion: also warm images referenced in article content (each /api/experiences/{id} body).

When a shielded build task fails after all waiters timed out, asyncio logs 'Task exception was never retrieved' with a traceback (seen in backend.err.log at 13:01:30). Add a done_callback that calls t.exception() (or logs it) to silence the noise.

integration_issues.issue: The frontend does not retry after a 503 from /api/img; a cold or slow image stays broken until reload. Optional: an onError handler that retries once or twice after ~10s (with a cache-bust param), honoring Retry-After.

action_items: Optional: pre-warm body/editor images from the article content, not just image_url
Optional: add a done_callback on IMG tasks to retrieve and log the exception (avoids 'Task exception was never retrieved')
Optional: client-side retry on image error (503 Retry-After)
critical_code_review_comments: Dedup, shield and background completion are implemented correctly; the done_callback pop keeps IMG_TASKS clean
httpx timeout=30 is per operation, so a trickling upstream can stretch one attempt well past 30s. The total task time is unbounded, but the client is protected by the 45s wait, so this is acceptable
No negative cache: a failing src is retried on every request (reasonable for transient SlowDown)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with -n 0 (test_iter5_dedup and test_iter4 concurrent tests rmtree /tmp/ynnck-img). Upstream log lines 'HTTP Request: GET <src>' in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log are used to count upstream hits. Upstream objects 3f4564a9 and editor/74ff2a08 can be very slow or 504; re-warm the cache after running destructive tests (heroes at w=800/1600 and the body image at 1200).
